verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page lists "Unlimited policy and approval workflows," and the MCP docs reference approval flows and identifying "who needs to approve" a transaction. That is first-party evidence of configurable approvals, but nothing confirms the specific chain structure or SLA handling the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented multi-step chains (manager, budget owner, finance), approver delegation, escalation or reminders when approvers sit on requests, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
